title: Find Anagram Mappings
description: Given two lists A and B where B is an anagram of A, return an index mapping array P such that A[i] = B[P[i]].

steps.note: Initialize an empty Map to store values and their indices in B.
Mapping values of B to their indices: 50 -> 0, 12 -> 1, 32 -> 2.
Looking up A[0]=12 in map, found index 1.
Looking up A[1]=28 in map, found index 0.
Looking up A[2]=46 in map, found index 2.
